builder.title: Build your own rotation
builder.body: Drag crops onto the timeline to design a rotation. The curves show what it does on your field, and the warnings flag rules it breaks.
builder.noField: Draw your field on the map first.
builder.design.name: My design
builder.palette.title: Crops
builder.palette.hint: Drag a crop onto the timeline. With a keyboard, press Enter to add it at the end, or Space to pick it up, the arrow keys to move it and Space to drop it.
builder.palette.add: {crop}, {detail}. Press Enter to add it to the timeline.
builder.timeline.title: Your rotation
builder.timeline.empty: Drop crops here, three to eight seasons. The rotation repeats through every season of your field's record.
builder.timeline.end: Drop here to add a season
builder.timeline.full: The timeline is full: {max} seasons is the most.
builder.curves.title: Live curves
builder.curves.body: What the rotation does on your field, averaged over the {seasons} replayed seasons. Each point is one season of the rotation.
builder.curves.empty: Add crops to see how they do on your field.
builder.curves.nitrogen: Nitrogen left by the previous crop
builder.curves.source: Source: ITZA season replay on your field's weather record ({seasons} seasons), crop values from the {pack} knowledge pack. {label}
builder.curves.error: The curves could not be computed: {message}
builder.warnings.title: Warnings
builder.warnings.none: No rule warnings for this design.
builder.score.hint: Replays your design through every season of your field and adds it as a card in the comparison.
builder.score.minimum: Add at least {min} seasons to score your design.
builder.score.blocked: This design cannot be laid out on your field's calendar. See the warnings.
builder.score.scored: Scored. It is a card in the comparison now.
builder.drag.instructions: To pick up a crop, press Space. Use the arrow keys to move it over a season of the timeline, then press Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
builder.drag.overEnd: {crop} is over the end of the timeline.
builder.drag.dropEnd: Dropped {crop} at the end of the timeline.
